label: Project Settings
title: Project Settings
subtitle: Updates project-level configuration settings including HITL mode, maximum reasoning steps, token limits, and other preferences.
whenToUse: Used by orchestrator agents or setup workflows that need to configure project settings programmatically at the start of a session.

methods.name: Update Project Settings
methods.description: Updates any project-level configuration field. Supports partial updates — only the fields you provide are changed.

mediaCaption: A Project Settings update action card showing the field updated and its new value
